method:
Onset/ending detail for clips the coarse raw-QA flag marked (speech-band
energy above -50 dBFS in the first/last 10 ms). The coarse flag cannot tell a
cut-off phoneme from a breath or ambience lead-in, so this characterises the
first and last 100 ms of every clip against the voice's own speech level:
 - envelope in 5 ms steps;
 - first-10 ms level relative to the clip's speech level (p90 of 10 ms
   frames) — a cut phoneme starts near speech level, a breath well below;
 - spectral centroid of the first 20 ms (fricative /s/ /f/ >~4 kHz);
 - rise from the first 5 ms to the 30-50 ms window: a lead-in that grows
   into the word, against a word already at level at sample 0.
The founder-approved validation clips of each voice are measured the same
way as reference. Usage: python -I onset_detail.py <repo> [stable_id ...]
